title: fix: stop child failures from flagging sidebar conversations
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: a recovered or promoted conversation keeps a sidebar failure warning because an old child run failed.

## User Impact

The sidebar reflects each conversation’s own failures, not historical child failures. Live delegated work, unread activity, approvals, questions, and agent-declared attention remain visible. Individual child failures remain available in their transcripts, and persistent child conversations retain their own failure indicators. No configuration or migration is required.

## Why This Change Was Made

Stop inheriting terminal failure attention and counts at the existing sidebar tree-summary owner, including cached sidebar restoration. Remove the superseded child-failure count, label, styling, and copy paths rather than adding dismissal state or another timer.

Requested by @steipete.

## Work sessions

- [Discussion, implementation and verification](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/~key/dashboard/e4ac7b94-ace6-460f-85aa-6215e6bb1ddc)

## Evidence

- CI repair: completed both test-type leaves (test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.ui-components.json and test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.ui-e2e.json), 10 snapshot tests, and the browser regression after adding the required snapshot pin state and correcting the child-list request matcher. Production behavior is unchanged. The hosted P2 fixture finding is fixed.

- Real Control UI browser regression using the mock Gateway: red on the base (inherited failure icon present), green with the fix, including reload. Test body: 3.59 seconds; complete browser lane including build/setup: 16.14 seconds. [Inspected before/after screenshots](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188309#issuecomment-6522436438) are attached in the proof comment.
- Nine focused UI files: **422 tests passed** in 27.92 seconds (30.11 seconds including wrapper). Coverage includes own failures, persistent child hovercards, delegated activity, approvals/questions, Home/roster summaries, and legacy snapshot ownership.
- UI typecheck, targeted lint, format, i18n verification, test-line ratchet, and diff checks passed. Existing Solid reactivity lint warnings are outside the changed lines.
- Local autoreview: complete local candidate against base `5eda466704861324a87e05a488cb10888e66b8a7`, P0–P2, scoped-clean; separate independent source review found no P0–P2 issues. Local ClawSweeper was unavailable because the existing runner checkout had unrelated changes; the selected fallback is local autoreview plus one hosted review request.
- Simplification removes inherited failure projection/state and keeps the existing owner. Regression tests add a net 55 lines, covered by a task-specific allocation for the rendered/reload and legacy-cache contracts; production code shrinks. CI timing will be available on the PR checks.

## Worked on by

- @steipete
